Function iup_delta_optimize

pub fn iup_delta_optimize(
    deltas: Vec<Vec2>,
    coords: Vec<Point>,
    tolerance: f64,
    contour_ends: &[usize],
) -> Result<Vec<GlyphDelta>, IupError>
Expand description

For the outline given in coords, with contour endpoints given ends, optimize a set of delta values deltas within error tolerance.

For each delta in the input, returns an GlyphDelta with a flag indicating whether or not it can be interpolated.
